title: Why GeneDx Holdings Stock Just Dropped 16.6%
author: Johnny Rice
description: GeneDx Holdings stock fell 16.6% after the company reported Q3 results that met revenue expectations at $123.1 million but fell short on testing volume growth. The company lowered its 2026 volume growth target to at least 28% from the previously promised 29.2% or more, marking the second downward revision this year. While the genetic testing company continues to grow, investors are concerned about the deceleration in core business metrics.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company missed on testing volume expectations (25% growth vs. 29.2% promised), lowered full-year volume growth guidance to 28%, and has now issued two downward revisions in 2026. The stock market punished this with a 16.6% single-day decline, indicating investor concern about decelerating growth despite meeting revenue targets. The company is priced on growth expectations, making these misses particularly damaging.

title: GeneDx Holdings Corp. (WGS) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
author: Na
description: GeneDx Holdings (WGS) reported quarterly earnings of $0.28 per share, significantly beating consensus estimates of $0.07, representing a 300% surprise. However, the stock has underperformed the market by 52.1% year-to-date. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

title: Agilon Health (AGL) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
author: Na
description: Agilon Health (AGL) reported quarterly earnings of $1.97 per share, significantly beating consensus estimates of a loss of $2.01 per share, representing a +198% earnings surprise. The company posted revenues of $1.52 billion, surpassing estimates by 4.43%. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. Agilon shares have gained 409.9% year-to-date, substantially outperforming the S&P 500's 10.6% gain.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company significantly beat earnings expectations (+198% surprise), exceeded revenue estimates by 4.43%, and has delivered exceptional year-to-date stock performance (+409.9%). However, sentiment is tempered by mixed estimate revisions and Hold rating, preventing a stronger positive rating.

Company has not yet reported results. Expected earnings show significant year-over-year decline (-85.7%), but revenue is expected to grow modestly (+4.6%). Consensus estimates remain unchanged, indicating stable but unexciting expectations.

title: Encompass Health Expands Rehab Footprint With New Maine Hospital
author: Na
description: Encompass Health Corporation (EHC) opened its first wholly owned hospital in Maine with 50 inpatient rehabilitation beds. Q2 2026 discharges rose 5.6% year-over-year, driven by new capacity and 2.8% same-store growth. EHC opened three hospitals in the first half of 2026 and plans to open eight new hospitals throughout the year, reflecting its strategy to expand capacity in favorable markets.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: EHC demonstrated strong growth with 5.6% increase in Q2 2026 discharges, successful opening of its first wholly owned Maine hospital, and aggressive expansion plans with eight new hospitals planned for 2026. Net patient revenue per discharge also increased 3.9%, indicating pricing power alongside volume growth.

Carries Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with two upward earnings revisions in the past 30 days. Beat earnings estimates in all trailing four quarters with 16.3% average surprise, and consensus revenue estimate suggests 8.7% year-over-year growth.

title: Should You Invest in the State Street SPDR S&P Health Care Services ETF (XHS)?
